rows.grounds: genitive plural of āgantuka, denoting those who arrive
genitive plural of sarva, qualifying both following groups
genitive plural of naiṣṭhika, denoting those established in a final observance
compound nivāsa-bhūḥ, the ground or place of residence

items.question: Which categories of people are housed in this dwelling place?
premises: The location functions as a dwelling place.
All newcomers are accommodated in this place.
All permanent vow-holders are accommodated in this place.
items.inference: This dwelling place provides residence for both transient newcomers and permanent vow-holders.
uncertainties: naiṣṭhikānāṃ may specifically denote ascetics in the final stage of observance.
items.plain_english: It is a dwelling place for all newcomers and for all those established in permanent vows.
